title: DECISION: AcceptAnyCert verifier for test TLS without system trust store
description: E2E tests that exercise authenticated commands (ENABLE IMAP4rev2, NAMESPACE) require a real TLS session because AUTH=PLAIN is only permitted over TLS. The tests generate an ephemeral self-signed cert with rcgen at test time so there is no cert to install in the OS trust store and the test is fully self-contained. AcceptAnyCert implements ServerCertVerifier by accepting any presented certificate. TLS12 and TLS13 signature verification are still delegated to the ring provider so the TLS handshake is genuine; only the cert chain check is bypassed. Alternative rejected: a test-only trust store seeded with the generated CA cert would work but requires more scaffolding and does not add meaningful security assurance in a same-process test.
